output.scope_note: The paper is about Li3YCl6 (a halide Li-ion solid electrolyte) and reports EIS ionic conductivities at room temperature for its samples, plus literature-cited conductivities.

records.evidence_quote: The measured ionic conductivity at 298 K (25°C) (of 0.49 mS cm−1 and 0.067 mS cm−1 ) and activation energy (of 0.41±0.006 eV and 0.47±0.004 eV)
records.notes: Ball-milled sample, not annealed. The EIS fit captures combined grain and grain boundary response, so this is a total pellet conductivity. Pellets were at 76-79% relative density (stated for the EIS pellets in general, not per sample), so relative density is left null. Activation energy 0.41 eV from the same sentence.

records.evidence_quote: The measured ionic conductivity at 298 K (25°C) (of 0.49 mS cm−1 and 0.067 mS cm−1 ) and activation energy (of 0.41±0.006 eV and 0.47±0.004 eV)
